defects: DEFECT-1 [HIGH, math — wrong weight power vs Eq.(31)]: crossterm_instrument.py:9-27 (header formula), :253-274 (compute_pair_sums), :896-899 (row emission). Production L_cat is Sigma_ball w_g N_g (bayesian_statistics.py:3900-3906 + weighted_sum :4024-4028; w_g=_rate_weight :964-987), so the factorized pair product's shared-galaxy diagonal terms carry w_g^2 (one factor from EACH event's galaxy sum) and the Eq.(31) paired marginalization replaces w_g^2*N_g,i*N_g,j -> w_g^2*J_g,ij. The instrument emits only w^1-weighted sums (sum_wJ=Sigma w_g J_g, sum_wN_i, sum_wN_j, sum_w, sum_wZ). PROOF of insufficiency (adversarial_refutation_checks.py/.json check C, this session): two toy universes with emitted rows identical to 1.7e-16 relative have true Eq.(31) cross-terms differing by 10.3% (0.013724 vs 0.015303 nats) — no analysis-layer convention (no K, no function of the emitted row) can recover the claimed object when n_shared>=2. Only n_shared==1 rows are salvageable (w^2 J = sum_w*sum_wJ; check A: instrument==brute force to 2.7e-15). Severity is NOT edge-case: M-4 zero-compute read (review_integrity_reads.py, frozeng posteriors_with_bh_mass/h_0_73.json ball sets x 279 filtered census pairs) gives n_shared>=2 in 55 of 63 nonzero-shared pairs (iiib/1d), 73 of 80 (joint_r1/1d), 4 of 5 (iiib/2d), 17 of 27 (joint_r1/2d); max n_shared 9898 (iiib/1d), 8861 (joint_r1/1d).

DEFECT-2 [HIGH, math — convenience delta violates the paper's perfect-redshift exactness limit]: crossterm_instrument.py:277-298 (delta_nats), :920 (delta_nats_K_sum_w). For n_shared>=2, as sigma_z->0 the true Eq.(31) cross-term -> 0 (P2, [LIT] section 2.3 quoted at CLAIM_HITCHHIKER_INDEPENDENCE_20260805.md.DRAFT:86-88: 'When galaxy redshifts are known perfectly, Eq. 15 is still exact'), but delta_nats(sums, K=sum_w) converges to the nonzero Chebyshev covariance term ln[(Sigma w l_i l_j)(Sigma w)/((Sigma w l_i)(Sigma w l_j))]. Measured (check B, 2 shared galaxies at z=0.35/0.47, w=1/3): delta_true = 0.0727 -> 0.0223 -> 0.0059 -> 0.0015 (O(sigma^2) -> 0) while delta_instrument = 0.0917 -> 0.0086 -> -0.0189 -> -0.0264, asymptote -0.02886 nats — WRONG SIGN vs truth at sigma_z<=0.005. The K needed to match truth drifts 3.925 -> 4.113 with sigma_z (sum_w=4.0 fixed): no fixed K exists, so the disclaim 'analysis layer owns K' cannot repair it. It is also not a one-sided bound (overstates 3x with wrong sign at sigma_z=0.005; understates in check C u2), so it cannot serve the pre-registered NEGLECT/REGARD band either.

DEFECT-3 [HIGH, math, 2D channel — factorized latent host mass]: crossterm_instrument.py:871-880 composes l_i=l_gw_i*mz_i and l_j=l_gw_j*mz_j so the joint integrand is gw_i*gw_j*mz_i*mz_j*rho, where each mz factor (make_mz_factor :609-644, mirroring bayesian_statistics.py:5080-5094) independently marginalizes ITS OWN copy of the shared galaxy's true-mass prior N(M; M_eff, sigma_M^2). The Eq.(31)-consistent pair term for a shared host must marginalize ONE shared latent M: integral N(mu_i;M,s_i^2) N(mu_j;M,s_j^2) N(M;M_g,sM^2) dM = N(mu_i;mu_j,s_i^2+s_j^2)*N(m_ij;M_g,v_ij+sM^2). Measured discrepancy at production-plausible sigma_M (60-200% per the mass-relation record) vs GW-conditional widths 3-12% (check D, closed form verified against adaptive quad to 1.3e-15/2.2e-6/4.4e-16 rel): +2.408 nats (concordant events, sM=0.6), -15.404 nats (discordant events, sM=0.6), +2.544 nats (sM=2.0) per shared galaxy. The header (:28-31) presents carrying both mz factors as the 2D cross-term with no acknowledgment that this is a factorized-M approximation unlicensed by Eq.(31); the same shared-latent argument that mandates the z coupling mandates the M coupling.

DEFECT-4 [MEDIUM, test coverage — the failing regime is exactly the untested one]: test_crossterm_toy.py:81-108 tests the pair-level delta only with a SINGLE shared galaxy (where the instrument is provably exact, check A); :111-130 tests multi-galaxy behavior only via PER-GALAXY residuals ln J_g - ln(N_i N_j), never the pair-level delta_nats over >=2 shared galaxies. The sigma_z->0 pair-level limit for n_shared>=2 — the paper's own exactness criterion and the dominant production configuration (DEFECT-1 counts) — is untested, which is why the shipped suite (7/7 passing, rerun this session) coexists with DEFECTS 1-2.

DEFECT-5 [LOW-MEDIUM, normalization convention — 'nats' are shared-set-conditional, not joint-ln-L nats]: even for salvageable n_shared==1 rows, converting the emitted quantities into the omitted term of the factorized joint ln L (posterior_combination.py:324, Sigma_i ln L_i) requires the full-ball raw sums Sigma_ball w N, the h-dependent global denominator (bayesian_statistics.py:4024-4028, absolute_marginal branch) relating raw sums to the emitted normalized L_cat_i/j, and the mixture weights w_G — the raw<->normalized conversion factor is emitted nowhere (rows carry only normalized L_cat and w_G, :908-919), so 'delta in nats' from this instrument alone is a conditional-on-shared-host quantity, not the Eq.(31) correction to the joint posterior in nats. Recoverable offline only by joining frozeng per-galaxy JSONs + the venue catalogue; meta's 'analysis layer owns K' does not document this gap and K-freedom cannot bridge it (DEFECT-1).
